verdict.rationale: Obsidian's Internal links docs say notes can be linked into a network of knowledge, and the Graph view core plugin visualizes relationships between notes. A community comment mentions using links/backlinks as LLM context, which implies backlinks exist. However, the pack never documents the [[wiki-style]] syntax, a backlinks panel, or unlinked-mention detection. missing for 10: explicit [[wiki-link]] syntax documentation, first-party evidence of a backlinks view showing context, any evidence of unlinked mentions, independent hands-on corroboration.
